title: Research sprint goal: The Windows host proves land, index reuse, the launcher and a clean setup
goal: The sprint goal's open questions whose kb coverage is weak are answered with the kb tools first and the live docs (Microsoft Learn) for the gaps, written as kb facts and gap entries through the kb skills: (1) whether and how Windows refuses renaming or deleting a directory that a process holds as its current working directory (the sharing/ERROR_SHARING_VIOLATION or access-denied behaviour BG-nlp5aat5 relies on); (2) what CREATE_BREAKAWAY_FROM_JOB, DETACHED_PROCESS and CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP do for a child that must outlive its parent's job object (ST-bgfsi3n2's launcher). The SessionEnd budget and Python install questions pack good and stand as findings.
